full_name: Andrew Wender Cohen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2005–2006 History American Fellow Syracuse University
bio: Andrew Wender Cohen is an associate professor of history at Syracuse University’s Maxwell School of Citizenship and Public Affairs specializing in American law and political economy.
